newsitem.title: USA: Intl Tech sees further business improvements.
newsitem.headline: Intl Tech sees further business improvements.

text.p: International Technology Corp expects "further improvements" in its business "consistent with the progress that has been made over the past two quarters," the company's chief executive, Anthony DeLuca, said.

DeLuca made his comments in a release containing the company's thrid-quarter results. The company said it lost $0.10 per share in the quarter, compared with a loss of $0.64 per share in the year-ago period.
DeLuca said the company is now focusing on "higher margin value-added services" for its clients, while lowering marketing and proposal costs.
The company's shares were unchanged in late morning trading at 8-3/4.
